name: summarize-semantic
summary: Build a deterministic extractive operational summary using Model2Vec static embeddings.
description: Independent alternate to report.summarize for the report.* chain. Splits source_fragments into sentences, ranks each by fixed-point cosine similarity of int8 Model2Vec (minishlab/potion-base-32M) mean-pool sums against the structured_facts centroid, keeps the top 3 in original order, and renders the same fixed template as report.summarize. Pure; hot path uses only integer arithmetic (no float).

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want browser and edge evidence folded into a named project summary via static embeddings, so that stakeholders see one deterministic operational narrative ranked by semantic overlap.

source_fragments: Browser adoption rose. Edge cache is warm.
structured_facts: Fact: edge — Edge cache is warm

output_example.summary: Acme Rollout combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 2 validated insights. Browser adoption rose. Edge cache is warm.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want a single validated insight to use singular wording when no project name is supplied, so that the default template still reads correctly under semantic ranking.

output_example.summary: The project combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 1 validated insight. Cloud latency improved.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want zero structured facts to still yield a header-only summary, so that an empty enrichment stage does not invent sentences under semantic ranking.

output_example.summary: The project combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 0 validated insights. Unrelated chatter here.

preconditions.description: Caller supplies source_fragments and structured_facts arrays (either may be empty).

postconditions.description: Identical input always yields an identical summary string. Sentence scoring uses int8 table lookup, i32 accumulation, and fixed-point cosine keys with no randomness, clocks, floats in the hot path, or host state.

side_effects.description: Produces one summary string in memory; does not log, persist, or transmit inputs.
